Blocks.Text: Application interview feedback should be sent via the Middleware Platform whenever they are created or updated in your ATS. As LinkedIn partners, use both your application identifier and interview feedback identifier when syncing application interview feedback via API.
Note
The latest API version is 202604. Use this version in the LinkedIn-Version header for all API requests to access the most recent features and improvements.
Note
Please submit batch calls grouped with no more than 100 records in sequential order.
Use the following endpoint to create and update application interview feedback:
PUT https://api.linkedin.com/v2/atsApplications/atsJobApplicationId={id1}&dataProvider=ATS&integrationContext={organization URN}/interviewFeedback?ids=INTFB123&ids=INTFB456

Rows.Text: Date record was created in your ATS
The person who interviewed the candidate and wrote this evaluation.
A list of final evaluations for this interview. Example of evaluations would be a final recommendation or an interview score.
Indicates which type of the interview the feedback was for.
Possible values are: PHONE_SCREEN or ONSITE
The first name of the actor.
The last name of the actor
The descriptive name about the qualification the candidate was evaluated for, for example "Verbal Communication", "Technical Qualifications".
The result of the evaluation, could be a final recommendation or an interview score.

Blocks.Text: Headers:

Authorization: Bearer {token}
x-restli-method: batch_update
Request Body:
A successful request will return a 200 OK response code, and you will find the status of each entity in the response body.
Note
Be sure to check the response for error statuses corresponding to individual entities you submit.

PUT https://api.linkedin.com/rest/applicationInterviewFeedbacks?ids[0].jobApplicationId={application_id}&ids[0].integrationContext=urn:li:organization:{org_id}&ids[0].interviewFeedbackId={interview_feedback_id}

Rows.Text: The person who interviewed the candidate and wrote the evaluation.
Possible values are: PHONE_SCREEN or ONSITE
The general feedback about the interview.
A list of final evaluations for this interview.
The timestamp when the feedback was last modified in your system.
The timestamp when the feedback was created in your system.
